fields.name: magic_ascii
fields.evidence: Both .sav files start 34 34 30 30 41 42 47 43 = '4400ABGC'. Code: FUN_080323d0 lines 6997-7000 byte-compare loop over 8 bytes; PACKET cold-reload probe confirms integrity failure handling.

fields.name: header_settings_group_a
fields.evidence: FUN_08020688 lines 4535-4540 and FUN_08021390 lines 4586-4590 are inverse byte-store patterns on the same struct offsets; FUN_0803242c line 7043 passes *(SaveManager+10) to FUN_080384b0.

fields.name: header_counter_field_w6
fields.evidence: Byte diff of the two real .sav files (only 2 bytes differ); PACKET probe_offset_hex 0xC with integrity_check_confirmed and reverted_to_blank_on_mutation. Empirically verified via headless mGBA boundary fuzzing (save rejection boundary: unsigned-range [1, 65535]).

fields.name: header_field_w7
fields.evidence: FUN_08020688 line 4537 and FUN_08021390 line 4588 operate on struct+0x0D bit7; observed bytes unchanged across captures.

fields.name: header_compensating_field_w8
fields.evidence: Two-sample diff; net word-sum delta 0 in both endiannesses; FUN_08020688 line 4540 / FUN_08021390 line 4590 for the +0x11 byte.

fields.name: header_erased_padding_w9_w10
fields.evidence: Both samples; EEPROM block granularity proven by FUN_08043564/FUN_08043628 (8-byte blocks) and FUN_0800a4bc/FUN_0800a524 (>>3 block conversion).

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.evidence: Python verification on both real files: BE words sum to 0x0000, computed -sum(others) = 0x0100 = stored. Code proof: FUN_08032364 lines 6946-6948, FUN_0803284c lines 7197-7202, FUN_080323d0 lines 6990-6995.

fields.name: slot_first_block_cleared
fields.evidence: Both samples show exactly 8 zero bytes at each of the three slot bases predicted by (slot*0x14+3)*8 and the 0x18+i*0xA0 loop in FUN_0803242c lines 7036-7041; all other slot bytes are 0xFF.

fields.name: slot_payload
fields.evidence: Exhaustive textual search for FUN_0800a524/func_0x0800a524 and 0xa0 uses in decompiled.c; both samples contain no non-FF slot payload byte beyond the cleared first block.

fields.name: tail_unused
fields.evidence: Slot offset formula (slot*0x14+3)*8 with slot max 2 and length 0xa0 in FUN_080327e0/FUN_0803242c; both samples are 0xFF at 0x1F8-0x1FF.
